mainEntity.name: Do I need to be experienced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at all. These workshops suit everyone from complete beginners to advanced photographers, and because the tuition is genuinely one-to-one, it's tailored to wherever you are. If you'd like extra support, I also offer private lessons and mentoring .

There are two situations. If the forecast before the workshop shows torrential or prolonged rain across the days, I may postpone and reschedule — though it's rare to get multiple days of those conditions. During the workshop itself, bad weather is rarely a problem: I'll switch the itinerary to find the driest areas and best chances, and for longer spells of rain we can run indoor tutoring, image reviews and editing sessions, so your time is always well spent.

mainEntity.name: How fit do I need to be?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every workshop carries a fitness rating (Easy, Moderate or Hard), shown in the summary details, so you can pick one that suits you. If you're unsure whether a particular workshop is right, just ask before booking and I'll talk you through what to expect.

mainEntity.name: Can my partner come along if they're not photographing?

acceptedAnswer.text: They're welcome to join us for breakfast and the evening meals if they'd like to, but they can't come out to the locations with the group while we're shooting — so they'll need to make their own arrangements during the day while we're out on location.

mainEntity.name: Is accommodation included, and will I have my own room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — your stay is included on a bed & breakfast basis, in a private room on single occupancy, with no single supplement to pay.

mainEntity.name: What camera and kit do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: A DSLR or mirrorless camera and any lenses you have. A tripod is essential, but I can lend you one (and a set of filters) if you let me know in advance. There's a full kit list in the Equipment section above, and my recommended equipment page goes into more detail.

mainEntity.name: Can I pay in instalments, or buy this as a gift?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes to both — there's an interest-free payment plan , and every workshop is available as a gift voucher .

You make your own way to the start point, and we travel together between locations once the workshop begins. Full details, including the limited pickup option, are in the Accommodation & Travel section above. If you've any questions, just get in touch .
